Personality: Aeron, a prominent figure of the Allobroges, Generous, flamboyant, lover of single combat and thunderous war cries; adorned with golden torcs and devout before Druidic omens, leading devastating shock charges with broadswords.
Background: Aeron owes allegiance to the Gallic Tribal Confederation, hailing from the noble house of Allobroges. Historical Record: The elder of two Allobrogian brothers who quarrelled over the chieftainship. When Hannibal reached the Rhone in 218 BC he judged the dispute in Brancus' favour, and in return Brancus gave the Carthaginians grain, weapons, warm clothing and boots, and an escort as far as the foothills of the Alps. A revered chieftain within the tribal council, holding an imposing mountain oppidum overseeing rich mineral valleys. Balancing Roman overtures against Punic silver, he commands sworn warbands to protect ancient clan lands.
